description: DWR Dam Safety Non-Jurisdictional Dam is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. A Non-Jurisdictional Dam is a dam creating a reservoir with a capacity of 100 acre-feet or less and a surface area of 20 acres or less and with a height measured as defined in Rules 4.2.5.1 and 4.2.19 of 10 feet or less. Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Water. Its tags are dam safety, nonjurisdictional dam, reservoir. The table has 36 columns. Attribution on the portal: DNR - Division of Water Resources. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
